definition.heading: What is Breast Cancer?
definition.content: Breast cancer occurs when abnormal cells grow uncontrollably in breast tissue and form a tumour. These cells may invade nearby tissues and, in some cases, spread to other parts of the body through the blood or lymphatic system.

actionable_insights.heading: Actionable Insights for Your Health
items: Prioritize vegetables, fruits, whole grains, legumes, and other nutrient-rich foods.
Stay physically active, maintain a healthy weight, and limit alcohol consumption.
Report new breast lumps, unusual nipple discharge, or persistent breast changes to a healthcare professional.
